name: First-run feedback (success or failure)

title: "First run: "
---

Thanks for trying the experimental alpha. Short answers are enough; use "unknown"
where needed. Do not attach files before checking them for private information.

## What did you try?

- Guide/link and step reached:
- OS and Python version:
- PrismBench version (if installed):
- Outcome: install failed / demo worked / real run worked / real run failed:
- What were you trying to learn about your own model or machine?

## What happened?

Paste a short reviewed error, or tell us what worked. What was the most confusing
step? Approximate setup time is helpful if you know it; separate downloads from
running the benchmark. No screenshot or complete log bundle is required.

## Only if you tried a real model (optional)

- GPU model/VRAM and llama.cpp version:
- Public model ID and quantization, if shareable:
- Attempt status and cleanup status, if available:

Synthetic demo numbers are not GPU measurements. For a full measured report use
the hardware reproduction template. Before sharing any files, read
[sharing results](https://github.com/JoeyJia02/prismbench/blob/main/docs/sharing-results.md):
paths, GPU UUIDs, token IDs and logs can identify your machine or reveal text.
Keep originals locally; disclose changes to a redacted copy. Never upload weights
or external account credentials.
